# Billing handbook

## Partner invoices

Grocery partners receive one invoice on the third business day of each month.
Deliveries, failed attempts and temperature credits are listed as separate lines.
Payment is due 30 days after the invoice date.

## History

Invoices were weekly until 2025; partner finance teams asked for monthly ones.

## Timing

# 배송 지연 예측 모델 검토 회의

## 입력 데이터

- 지난 8주 동안 정류장별 실제 도착 시각

- 차량 적재율과 정류장 수
- 물류센터 출발 지연 기록

## 성능

- 15분 넘는 지연을 82% 정확도로 미리 맞혔다.
- 비 오는 날 저녁에는 정확도가 70%로 떨어졌다.

## 다음 단계

- 아파트 단지 출입 대기 시간을 입력에 넣어 본다.

# Retrospective: rooftop drone trial

## What we tried

For six weeks we flew small parcels from the Bayview depot roof to two apartment blocks.

## Why we stopped

- The aircraft could lift 2.5 kg, while a typical basket weighs about 9 kg.
- Insulated boxes added weight and left even less room for groceries.
- Every flight needed a separate permit, so a route could not be planned a day ahead.

## What we keep

The landing-pad survey of the two blocks is reused for van access notes.

files.sources/finance-meeting-2026-05.md:
# 정산팀 회의 — 2026년 5월

## 참석

정산팀장, 고객지원 리드, 결제 담당 개발자

## 논의

- 환불 처리 대기 시간이 평균 2일이라 고객 불만이 많다.
- 상담원이 바로 처리할 수 있는 환불 한도를 3만 원에서 5만 원으로 올리자는 제안이 나왔다.
- 5만 원을 넘는 환불은 지금처럼 정산팀장이 승인한다.
- 한 고객이 한 달에 세 번 넘게 환불을 받으면 검토 대기열로 보낸다.

## 결정

- 상담원 한도 5만 원은 6월 1일부터 적용한다.

# Interview: store manager at Greenleaf Market

## What we heard

- They like seeing a photo when goods arrive.
- They would order more frozen goods if delivery were earlier.
- They asked for a single contact for all their stores.
- Drivers sometimes block the loading bay during the lunch rush.

## Next

# 기사 근무 규정 2026

## 야간 근무

- 밤 10시부터 아침 6시 사이에 일하는 기사는 2시간마다 15분씩 쉰다.
- 야간 근무는 연속 사흘을 넘길 수 없다.

## 확인 방법

- 휴식은 앱의 정차 기록으로 확인한다. 휴식을 건너뛰면 다음 배차가 막힌다.
files.sources/lost-package-runbook.md:
# 분실 배송 조사 절차

## 1단계: 기록 확인

배송 시각의 GPS 위치와 도착 사진을 확인한다.

## 2단계: 기사 연락

담당 기사에게 전화해 물건을 둔 위치를 묻는다.

## 3단계: 결론

48시간 안에 결론을 낸다. 결론을 내지 못하면 고객에게 다시 보낸다.
files.sources/notification-meeting-notes.md:
# 고객 알림 채널 회의

## 문제

- 문자 발송 비용이 한 달 1,800만 원을 넘었다.
- 문자로는 도착 사진을 함께 보여 줄 수 없다.

## 결정

- 2026년 2월부터 배송 출발과 도착 안내는 앱 푸시로 보낸다.
- 앱을 설치하지 않은 고객에게만 문자를 보낸다.

# Partner API limits

## Rate limit

Each API key may send 600 requests per minute.
Over the limit, the API answers HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

## Batch

The batch endpoint accepts up to 500 orders in one request.

## Why per key

Partners call from many servers with one key, so limits by IP address were unfair.
files.sources/postmortem-2026-03-freezer.md:
# Postmortem: Riverside freezer room failure, 14 March 2026

## Summary

The main compressor of the Riverside freezer room failed at 02:10.
By 05:00 the room had warmed to minus 9 °C and 3,100 kg of stock was discarded.

## What we learned

- The room's alarm emails went to a shared mailbox nobody watched at night.
- There was no second compressor to take over.
- Nobody had tested the alarm path since the room opened.

## Actions

- Freezer room alarms now page the control room.
- A backup compressor was installed in April.
- The alarm path is tested every Monday.

# RFC: coldhold-v2

## Problem

Excursion rules lived inside the alerting service, so a rule change meant redeploying alert delivery.

## Design

coldhold-v2 receives every sensor reading and decides whether an excursion has started.
It keeps the last 6 hours of readings per vehicle in memory.
Alert delivery stays in the alerting service and only receives decisions.

## Rollout

coldhold-v2 replaced the old rule engine in May 2026.

# RFC: 적재칸 온도 경보 기준

## 배경

지난 분기 관제 화면에 뜬 경보의 절반 이상이 문을 잠깐 연 사이의 순간적인 온도 튐이었다.
관제 담당자들이 경보를 무시하기 시작했다는 보고가 있었다.

## 제안

냉동 적재칸은 영하 18도보다 따뜻한 상태가 10분 넘게 이어질 때만 경보를 보낸다.
냉장 적재칸은 0도에서 5도 범위를 벗어난 상태가 15분 이어질 때 경보를 보낸다.
경보는 기사 앱과 관제 화면에 동시에 띄운다.

## 결정

제안대로 지속 시간 조건을 둔다. 다음 분기에 오탐률을 다시 잰다.

# RFC: one route planner for every depot

## Context

Each depot ran its own planning server. Fourteen servers had to be patched by hand,
and a planner could not see traffic data from a neighbouring depot.

## Proposal

Run the planner as one central service in a single cloud region with a warm standby.

## Outcome

Since January 2026, planning a full depot day takes 90 seconds instead of 11 minutes.

# How we estimate emissions per drop

## Method

Each delivery takes a share of its route's distance, weighted by parcel volume.
That distance is multiplied by the vehicle's fuel factor.
Refrigeration unit runtime is added at 0.8 kg CO2e per hour.

## Limits

Electric vans use the grid average for the month, not the depot's own tariff.

# Warehouse standard operating procedure

## Receiving

Pallets are scanned at the dock door and moved to their temperature zone.

## Dock dwell

Chilled pallets may stay on the loading dock for at most 20 minutes.
Frozen pallets get 10 minutes before they must return to the freezer room.
The dock scanner starts the clock when a pallet label is first scanned outside the cold room.

## Picking

Pickers wear insulated gloves in the freezer room and rotate out every 45 minutes.

The service that detects temperature excursions from sensor readings.

## Facts

- coldhold-v2 receives every sensor reading and decides whether an excursion has started. [[src:sources/rfc-coldhold-v2.md#l9]]
- It replaced the rule engine inside the alerting service in May 2026. [[src:sources/rfc-coldhold-v2.md#l15]]
- It keeps the last 6 hours of readings per vehicle in memory. [[src:sources/rfc-coldhold-v2.md#l10]]

## Decisions

- Excursion detection was split from alert delivery so each can be deployed separately. [[src:sources/rfc-coldhold-v2.md#l5]]

How quickly support answers a complaint about temperature.

## Facts

- Temperature complaints must get a first human reply within 2 hours during business hours. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-01-09-1.md#l5]]
- Complaints received overnight are answered by 09:30 the next morning. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-01-09-1.md#l5]]

summary: When the refrigeration unit melts frost off its evaporator coil.
---

## Summary

When the refrigeration unit melts frost off its evaporator coil.

## Facts

- Reefer evaporators run a defrost cycle every 6 hours. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-09-19-18.md#l5]]
- A cycle lasts about 12 minutes and pauses cooling in that compartment. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-09-19-18.md#l11]]
- Defrost is skipped while the cargo door is open. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-09-19-18.md#l9]]

## Decisions

- Defrost timing moved to the gaps between stops so it never overlaps unloading. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-09-19-18.md#l9]]

## Summary

How the arrival window is presented to shoppers before and on the delivery day.

## Facts

- Shoppers see a two-hour delivery window at checkout. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-06-27-27.md#l9]]
- On the delivery day the window narrows to 30 minutes once the driver is three stops away. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-06-27-27.md#l9]]
- Windows are shown in the shopper's local time zone. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-06-27-27.md#l12]]

## Decisions

- We stopped showing an exact minute because late arrivals against an exact time drove most complaints. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-06-27-27.md#l5]]

냉동 적재칸과 냉장 적재칸의 온도 경보가 언제 울리는지 정리했다.

## Facts

- 냉동 적재칸은 영하 18도보다 따뜻한 상태가 10분 넘게 이어지면 경보를 보낸다. [[src:sources/rfc-reefer-alarms.md#l10]]
- 냉장 적재칸의 경보 기준은 0도에서 5도 범위를 벗어난 상태가 15분 이어질 때다. [[src:sources/rfc-reefer-alarms.md#l11]]
- 경보는 기사 앱과 관제 화면에 동시에 뜬다. [[src:sources/rfc-reefer-alarms.md#l12]]

## Decisions

- 순간적인 온도 튐 때문에 경보가 남발되어, 즉시 경보 대신 지속 시간 조건을 두기로 했다. [[src:sources/rfc-reefer-alarms.md#l16]]

## Summary

호남 지역 배송을 맡는 광주 물류센터의 개소 기록이다.

## Facts

- 광주 물류센터는 2026년 4월 7일에 첫 출고를 했다. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-01-02-28.md#l5]]
- 냉동 창고 1,200㎡와 냉장 창고 800㎡로 시작했다. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-01-02-28.md#l5]]
- 첫 달 하루 평균 출고량은 410건이었다. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-01-02-28.md#l5]]

## Decisions

- 호남 지역 배송을 대전에서 광주로 옮겨 평균 이동 시간을 50분 줄이기로 했다. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-01-02-28.md#l5]]

## Summary

What happens to the gel packs that travel with chilled goods.

## Facts

- Gel packs are collected at the next delivery and reused up to 8 times. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-07-18-7.md#l5]]
- Each pack is washed and frozen for 24 hours before it goes out again. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-07-18-7.md#l5]]
- Packs with leaks are discarded. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-07-18-7.md#l5]]

## Decisions

- Shoppers who return packs get no deposit; collection is part of the service. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-07-18-7.md#l5]]

## Summary

How the planner keeps changes to one route from colliding.

## Facts

- Only one planner can change a route at a time. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-02-15-38.md#l5]]
- Opening a route takes a 5-minute lease that renews while the planner is active. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-02-15-38.md#l13]]
- Others see the route read-only, with the lease holder's name. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-02-15-38.md#l13]]

## Decisions

- A lease was chosen over merging edits because stop order cannot be merged safely. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-02-15-38.md#l5]]

- Route planning ran on a server in each depot until January 2026. [[src:sources/rfc-route-planner-cloud.md#l5]]

- A sensor is swapped when its battery drops below 20 percent. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-09-28-33.md#l11]]
- Swaps happen at the depot during the morning vehicle check. [[src:sources/ops-sync-2026-09-28-33.md#l5]]
